data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin for the Singular SDK to track events, revenue, and deep links.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Singular SDK into a Flutter application for tracking events, reporting custom and in-app purchase revenues, handling deep links, and managing device tokens for uninstall tracking on Android and iOS.
use_when: You need to integrate Singular attribution and analytics in your mobile app.
You want to track in-app purchases and custom events with Singular.
You need to handle Singular Links (deep linking) and SKAdNetwork features.
avoid_when: You are not using Singular for mobile attribution and analytics.
You only need generic local state management or other non-analytics features.
strengths: Provides full support for Singular features including events, revenues, and deep links.
Supports both Android and iOS platforms.
Includes support for SKAdNetwork and uninstall tracking.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration in native AppDelegate/SceneDelegate or MainActivity files.
Tied entirely to the Singular ecosystem.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the dependency, configuring API keys, and performing native platform setup in iOS (AppDelegate or SceneDelegate) and Android (MainActivity).

alternatives.name: newrelic_mobile
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose this if you need application performance monitoring (APM) and crash reporting instead of marketing attribution.
